newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list LEAPS Nov 4 on HFS Inc.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list LEAPS Nov 4 on HFS Inc.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said on Friday it will list Long-Term Equity Anticipation Securities (LEAPS) on November 4 on stock of HFS Inc.
The new HFS LEAPS will have strike prices of 60, 75 and 90, with expirations in January 1998 and January 1999.
Equity LEAPS trade in units of 100 shares of stocks, feature American-style exercise and settle in stock.
Trading hours are 0830 CST/1430 GMT to 1510 CST/2110 GMT. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
